title: Identity asserted from a client-controlled source
primary_mitigation: Identity read only from requestContext.authorizer.jwt.claims; local adapter blocked by three independent guards; secure-by-default config
next_action: Add WAF rule stripping X-Local-* at the edge

title: Access-token theft or replay
primary_mitigation: Short access-token TTL; optional MFA; advanced security mode; TLS; no-store caching; per-request audit logging
next_action: Mandate MFA for admin role in production; shorten access-token TTL

title: Token not issued for this API is accepted
primary_mitigation: Authorizer pins issuer and audience to Terraform-managed pool and client; membership record provides defence in depth
next_action: Add CI policy asserting authorizer audience is non-empty

title: Mass assignment of server-controlled fields
primary_mitigation: extra=forbid on every request model; organization_id/created_by/ticket_id absent from request models; CLIENT_UPDATABLE_FIELDS allow-list; frozen domain model
next_action: Add CI schema test forbidding server-controlled field names in request models

title: Client input manipulates DynamoDB keys
primary_mitigation: Cursor validated against caller partition at service and repository layers; ticket_id typed UUID at the edge; key builders reject the # separator

title: Membership record manipulation
primary_mitigation: No application endpoint writes memberships; explicit IAM Deny on delete/bulk-write; permissions boundary; PITR; role_claim_mismatch alarm
next_action: Split memberships into a separate table so the execution role can be read-only on it

title: Loss of attribution or forged log records
primary_mitigation: Strict request-id sanitisation; json.dumps newline escaping; static log messages with truncation; mandatory security events on every denial
next_action: Archive logs to S3 with Object Lock for tamper-evident retention (SR-L12)

title: Silent overwrite destroys ticket history
primary_mitigation: Conditional writes (attribute_not_exists on create, attribute_exists on update); closed is terminal; no DeleteItem grant plus explicit Deny; PITR

title: Cross-tenant read through an unscoped query
primary_mitigation: No Scan in any read path; partition key from verified principal; GSI1 keyed on tenant AND user; explicit IAM Deny on dynamodb:Scan
next_action: Add a CI lint rule failing on the literal .scan( in application/

title: Error responses disclose existence or internals
primary_mitigation: Uniform error envelope with no trace or exception text; 404 for cross-tenant and absent alike; validation errors omit submitted values; identical denial message
next_action: Add per-principal rate limiting on 404 responses

title: Customer content or credentials written to logs
primary_mitigation: Field allow-list (not deny-list); identifiers and outcomes only; changed field names not values; Authorization-header debug branch removed; CMK-encrypted log groups with retention
next_action: Add a CloudWatch Logs data-protection policy as an independent second layer

title: Query amplification and unbounded result sets
primary_mitigation: limit bounded 1-100 at the edge and re-clamped in the repository; field length maxima; 1 KB cursor cap; stage throttling; reserved concurrency

title: Concurrency and cost exhaustion from request floods
primary_mitigation: Stage rate and burst throttling; reserved concurrency; rejection at the authorizer before application code; throttle alarms
verification: Not verified - load testing out of scope without a deployment
next_action: Add AWS WAF rate-based rules and per-tenant usage plans; add a billing alarm

title: Privilege escalation via self-asserted role
primary_mitigation: Role resolved from server-side membership record; active status required; Cognito app client has no write access to custom:role or custom:organization_id; mismatch alarmed

title: Missing authorization enforcement on a write path
primary_mitigation: Explicit Decision objects passed to enforce(); enforcement concentrated in the service layer; three ordered checks on update; closure is admin-only and closed is terminal
next_action: Add a CI assertion that every principal-taking service method calls enforce()

title: Over-privileged Lambda execution role
primary_mitigation: Enumerated actions (GetItem/PutItem/Query only); ARN-scoped resources; unused actions omitted; explicit Deny on Scan destructive and self-modification actions; permissions boundary; kms:ViaService condition; policies gated by the project IAM analyzer in CI
verification: security-automation/iam_policy_checker.py run 2026-10-23 - 1 INFO 0 blocking; AWS enforcement unverified
next_action: Run IAM Access Analyzer policy validation once an AWS account is available
